current_events: U.S president Donald Trump at 5:30 p.m. ET local time in Washington and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announce that the United States and Iran have reached an agreement to end the war, extend the ceasefire by 60 more days, and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with the deal set to be officially signed in Switzerland on Friday
Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war, Islamabad Memorandum
Mediators from Qatar travel to Tehran, Iran, to finalize the ceasefire agreement between Iran and the United States to end the war
2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations
U.S. president Donald Trump authorizes the end of the blockade imposed since April 13 after announcing on Truth Social that an agreement has been reached
2026 United States naval blockade of Iran

U.S. defense secretary Pete Hegseth says that the U.S. has maintained control of the Strait of Hormuz, and states that the U.S. has guided 125 million barrels of oil through Operation Project Freedom despite regional tensions
2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign
Lebanon's health ministry reports that an Israeli attack on the Dahieh suburb of Beirut killed three people and injured 16

The Israeli military confirms that Hezbollah commander Ali Musa Daqduq, who was responsible for orchestrating the killing of five American troops in Iraq during the Iraq War, has been killed in a recent airstrike in southern Lebanon
Rapid Support Forces launch drone strikes on El-Obeid, North Kordofan, targeting a fuel station at the El Obeid Airport district and a fuel storage tank
British Royal Marines storm and seize a Russian shadow fleet tanker in the English Channel
Russia–United Kingdom relations
Oil prices, including crude oil, fall by 5% after Trump announced that a deal has been reached to end the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the U.S. blockade
Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war
Twelve people are killed when a plane carrying skydivers crashes in Butler, Missouri, United States
At least six people, including American singer Oliver Tree and Argentine Youtuber Gaspi, are killed when two helicopters collide and crash into a parking lot in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
2026 Rio de Janeiro mid-air collision
Six people are killed after a pickup truck collides with a parked truck in Ejin Banner, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China
Police arrest 63 people outside Madison Square Garden in New York City, U.S., after 10 police officers were injured during celebrations of the New York Knicks winning the NBA Finals
Gunshots are reported overnight on 42nd Street and Broadway in New York City with one teen shot and several buses being damaged during celebrations
Swiss voters reject an initiative to cap Switzerland's permanent resident population at 10 million by 2050
In endurance racing, Toyota Racing wins the 24 Hours of Le Mans with drivers Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi, and Nyck de Vries. It is Toyota's first victory in the event since 2022
